verdict.rationale: First-party docs only show automatic daily backups on Pro, Team and Enterprise plans, which is snapshot-level rather than any-point-in-time recovery. Supabase's PITR appears only indirectly, in a community thread where the CEO said they would investigate moving users to it. Branching is documented for preview and test environments, not for branching from a past point in time. missing for 10: first-party docs on point-in-time restore and its retention window, a documented restore workflow, point-in-time branching or forking of the database, and independent hands-on corroboration of recovery from bad writes.

support.subject: As a platform-engineer, I can restore or branch the database to any point in time within the retention window to recover from bad writes

citations.quote: We automatically back up all Pro, Team, and Enterprise Plan projects on a daily basis.
Supabase CEO confirmed and said they'd investigate moving users to PITR.
